notes: The two resumptive suffixes are realized by the English relatives 'which'/'Which' under rule 18's relative-pronoun clause; marking them unrepresented and leaving the relatives added was rejected because a pronominal morpheme stands in each clause.
t017 and t025-t026 are ASV supplies with no morpheme to license them: no conjunction stands between the two prepositional phrases (rule 14), and the last clause writes no verb at all (rule 20).
